title: fix(service-analytics): a dataset refuses a measure currency that contradicts its field's fixed code, and a derived measure across two different fixed codes
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D5QoSbzQb2Lqa8sG8mU6Fiz)_
Fixes #27579

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md, content/docs/data-modeling/currency.mdx, content/docs/api/data-api.mdx

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：数据集编译时新增两条只针对 `fixed` 币种的拒收。度量写的 `currency` 和被汇总字段的 `fixed` 币种不同，拒收；派生度量（任何运算）的两个金额操作数落在两个不同的 `fixed` 币种，拒收。都返回 `DATASET_INVALID` / 400，并给出改法。
- 为什么改：这两种写法今天会算出不报错的错数（EUR 字段被标成 USD，或 USD 减 EUR 不带币种）。维护者裁决 6486427200（ADR-0144 Open item 12，字母 A）。
- 风险与回滚：这是收窄，以前能编译的这两种写法现在被拒。仓内数据集元数据实测 0 处命中；已部署租户存的数据集无法从仓库调查，它们会在注册与请求时被拒，错误信息写明改法。回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-analytics/src/measure-currency-coherence.ts`（两个 `fixed` 分支与 `fixed` 标记），`packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/record-currency-analytics.test.ts`（三道门的 pin 与对照）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run src/__tests__/record-currency-analytics.test.ts`，预期 42 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`assertMeasureCurrenciesCoherent` (`measure-currency-coherence.ts`), called once from `compileDataset`, gains the `fixed` arm of each guard. The record-mode arms from #27338 are unchanged.

- **Shape 1.** An aggregated measure whose `currency` differs from its field's `fixed` code refuses with `DATASET_INVALID` / 400. The message names the measure, the field, the object and both codes, and the fix: delete the measure's `currency`, and the column takes the field's code. A `currency` that restates the `fixed` code is accepted.
- **Shape 2.** A derived measure, for every op (`sum`, `difference`, `ratio`, `product`), whose monetary operands resolve to two different `fixed` codes refuses with `DATASET_INVALID` / 400, naming both operands, their codes and the fix (derive it from measures in one currency, or drop the operand in the other). A derived `sum` / `difference` over one `fixed` code resolves to that code, so a derived measure built on it is judged at the next level. A `count` operand is not compared.
- **What a `fixed` code is.** A resolved code now carries `fixed`: true when it is the field's `fixed` code, restated by the measure or not. A derived `sum` / `difference` is `fixed` when every operand is. Shape 2 compares only `fixed` codes.
- **Not judged, unchanged:** a `fixed` code against the tenant currency; a measure `currency` over a `dynamic` field. Because the ruling lists the second as legal, an operand whose code is such an explicit one is not a `fixed` code, and Shape 2 does not compare it (see Acceptance notes).
- **Moved pins.** Starting from #27338's first draft (`80b98fb8`, dropped at `507ed8f9`): `currency-mode-relay.test.ts`'s `m_explicit_fixed` restates the fixed field's `EUR` instead of contradicting it with `JPY`, and `query-dataset.test.ts`'s chain pin moves to a `dynamic` field.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/service-analytics` **minor**, with a BREAKING paragraph, both declaration lines, and the ADR-0087 marker `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

## Tests

`record-currency-analytics.test.ts`, guard block (real engine over SQLite, through `AnalyticsServicePlugin`):

- Shape 1 refused at registration, naming the fix; restated code accepted (control); a `currency` over a `dynamic` field not judged (control).
- Shape 2 refused for each of the four ops, naming the fix; refused one level up through a derived `sum` of one `fixed` code; a `fixed` operand restated by its measure code compares by that one code (control); an explicit code over a `dynamic` field against a `fixed` one is not judged (control); amount per invoice over each `fixed` code, and a `fixed` amount with the tenant currency, accepted (controls).
- The request door and the Studio draft preview: `queryDataset`, with and without `previewDrafts`, refuses both shapes with `DATASET_INVALID` / 400 naming the measure; a restated code is served with `currency: 'EUR'` on both (control).
- The old "not judged" controls for the two `fixed` shapes are replaced by the pins above.

## Acceptance notes

- **The in-tree survey: 0 of either shape.** I searched dataset metadata in `examples/**`, `packages/platform-objects/**`, `packages/runtime/src/seed-datasets.ts`, `ui/examples/**` and the skills evals. 16 files declare `measures:`, and none sets a measure `currency`. The two derived measures in the tree (`chart-gallery.dataset.ts`, `revenue-pulse.dataset.ts`) are both ratios of two counts. A deployed tenant's stored datasets cannot be surveyed from the repository: a stored dataset with either shape now refuses at registration and at query, and its message names the edit.
- **One reading the ruling leaves open, for the contract review.** The ruling says Shape 2 compares operands that "resolve to two different `fixed` codes", and lists "a measure `currency` over a `dynamic` field" as legal. #27338's first draft compared any two resolved codes, so it also refused a derived measure over an explicit `JPY` on a `dynamic` field and a `fixed` `USD`. This PR follows the ruling's words: only `fixed` codes are compared, and a CONTROL pins that pair as accepted. Refusing that pair too would narrow further, and would need its own ruling.
- **Skills and docs: follow-up owed.** `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` says "Under `'fixed'`/`'dynamic'` a measure's own `currency` wins", which this PR makes false for a contradicting `fixed` code. `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` (the currency chain comment), `content/docs/data-modeling/currency.mdx` (Roll-ups and datasets) and `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx` (the currency chain) describe the record-mode refusals only. None is in this card's file surface. Grep: `git grep -n -iE "measure.{0,40}currency|currency.{0,40}measure" -- 'skills/**' 'content/docs/**'`.
- **`dataset-compiler.ts`.** The comment above the `assertMeasureCurrenciesCoherent` call names only the record-mode arms. It is outside the file surface and is incomplete rather than false, so this PR leaves it.
- The ADR-0144 Open item 12 dated note stays with the epic PM, as the ruling says.

## Verification

Head `c053f4ca` (base `bacb3e6a`).

<details><summary>Red on the base, ablations, restore</summary>

- The new and moved pins against the unchanged `measure-currency-coherence.ts` of `bacb3e6a`: 10 red, 83 green over the three files. Red: Shape 1 at registration, Shape 2 for each of the four ops, Shape 2 one level up, and both shapes at `queryDataset` and at the draft preview. Every control was green (restated code, `dynamic` field, `count` operand, tenant currency, explicit code over a `dynamic` field).
- Through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 → 0, restored blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty after each). The tests import the source, so no build was needed between legs.
  - Shape 1 arm disabled: 3 red (registration, `queryDataset`, preview), 39 green.
  - Shape 2 `fixed` pair disabled: 7 red (four ops, one level up, `queryDataset`, preview), 35 green.
  - An explicit code over a `dynamic` field marked `fixed`: 1 red (the CONTROL that pins it as not judged), 41 green.

</details>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics test`: 196 files, 4752 passed, 282 skipped. `typecheck` exit 0 (its `include` is `src`, tests included).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 59 derived families, all run. `--ran` reconciliation: "59 derived, 58 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". 58 exited 0. NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3 (prerequisite: a whole-tree build; this run built only the dogfood closure and `@objectstack/service-analytics`). CI runs it.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.
- Full dogfood battery (the `(narrowing)` arm), `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock at `c053f4ca`: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 357 passed and 3 skipped (360), Tests 2875 passed and 20 skipped (2895), no failures.
